scheme_name: Reported one-time challan amnesty (no order published)
note: No challan amnesty is in force in Delhi. A one-time amnesty has been reported repeatedly in the press since late 2025, the reporting saying it stalled on legal advice that challans already before a court cannot be waived without judicial approval — but we have found no notification, gazette entry or departmental order for it, and press reporting alone is not evidence of an order under our sourcing rule. Treat the scheme as reported, not enacted, and expect no discount until an order is actually published. Delhi's settlement routes that do exist are the National Lok Adalat token system, the weekday evening traffic courts, and weekend traffic courts running at district court complexes since July 2026.
